lab_questions.title: E-Commerce Inventory Race Condition
lab_questions.description: Fix a classic database concurrency bug known as a Race Condition (TOCTOU vulnerability) in a Django application to prevent overselling inventory during simultaneous checkouts.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Fix the TOCTOU Vulnerability in Checkout
tasks.description: Modify the `buy_vulnerable` view in `store/views.py` to fix the race condition. Instead of checking the stock in Python memory and then updating, use an atomic database update query using Django's `F` expression and a `filter(stock__gt=0)` to ensure concurrent requests cannot drop the stock below zero.
